Ordinary words, function words, punctuation, whitespace, digits and code identifiers stay at the floor - the same piece inside a common word (simple, table, bottle) or standing as its own word (Cal abria, Col abello) is silent - though a weaker diffuse component (0.1-0.4 x max) lifts ordinary content words in passages dense with such words, and that leftover is not explained by this hypothesis.
